_source: Feeding San Diego find-food map, retrieved 2026-08-16. Facts only (name, address, hours, phone, eligibility). Descriptions rewritten. Verify against feedingsandiego.org before publishing.
_schema_note: These are SERVICES with operating hours, not dated events. Each entry produces ONE document. Do NOT run recurrence expansion on this file: schedules like '2nd and 4th Saturday' cannot be represented by the app's recurrence enum (none|weekly|monthly|annually), and expanding weekly sites would generate 600+ documents. The seeder needs a services branch that writes scheduleText into the description and skips date expansion.
_critical: Eligibility must travel with every entry. Appointment-only, call-first, zip restrictions, seniors-only, 21+, and proof-of-enrollment conditions are the difference between someone getting food and getting turned away.
Every entry with a phone number should surface it prominently. These schedules change with holidays and weather, per the source page. Be a router to the provider, not the source of truth.
Coordinates are not included. Geocode from the address field using your existing Mapbox token before seeding. Do not guess.
_excluded: Summer Food Service Program: Linda Vista (Parks After Dark), 7064 Levant St - program window was 7/9 to 8/1, already ended
Summer Food Service Program: City Heights (Parks After Dark), 4380 Landis St - same, already ended
